name: Exa MCP
tagline: Neural web search for AI — semantic similarity, not just keyword matching.
shortDescription: The Exa MCP server. Neural search that finds pages by semantic similarity, not just keyword overlap. Good for research tasks where you want "articles similar to this one" or "papers about X concept".
longDescription:
## What it is

The Exa MCP server, by Exa Labs. Exa is a neural search engine: instead of matching keywords, it embeds both the query and the pages, then finds pages whose embeddings are closest. Great for research-style queries where the user describes a concept, not keywords.

## Why we recommend it

Traditional search engines (including Brave and Perplexity) are still keyword-based underneath. Exa is genuinely semantic — it can find "articles that explain X concept well" even when the article doesn't use the exact term. For agent research tasks, the quality of results is noticeably better than keyword-based search.

## When to use it

- Research tasks where you describe a concept, not keywords
- Finding similar articles to a reference you already have
- Discovering academic papers on a topic
- Competitive research: finding pages that explain a topic well
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys
2. Set `EXA_API_KEY=...`
3. `uvx mcp-exa`

**Pricing note:** Exa charges per search. Free tier gives ~1000 searches/month.
pricingDetails: Free MCP server. Exa: $10 free credit for new accounts, then pay-as-you-go per search.
